scripts.build: npm run build:chrome && npm run build:firefox
scripts.build:chrome: ../frontend/node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist-v3-1/chrome && node scripts/copy-static.mjs chrome dist-v3-1/chrome
scripts.build:firefox: ../frontend/node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json --outDir dist-v3-1/firefox && node scripts/copy-static.mjs firefox dist-v3-1/firefox
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
